## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and both suites pass (`python -m unittest discover -s tests/unit`, `python tests/test_runner.py`)
- [ ] `ruff check src/ tests/ scripts/` passes
- [ ] Documentation updated where behaviour, messages or labels changed (and `node .github/scripts/check-docs.mjs` passes)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry under the top (unreleased) version, crediting outside contributors
- [ ] If it changes what Fusion shows or how it behaves in Fusion: tested in real Fusion (which version?), or the new check is added to `tests/MANUAL_CHECKLIST.md`
- [ ] No tokens, passwords or private designs in the code, tests, logs or screenshots
